prompts.name: Focused College Explorer
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one highly polished, flat front-facing desktop screenshot of ONLY the SECOND SECTION of the NSEDU Indian college discovery homepage, landscape approximately 1600 x 900. This is a new downstream section, not a redesign of the hero. Use the approved reference image solely as brand style reference. Preserve its professional editorial wine and warm taupe styling, refined typography and thin icons. Do NOT include the reference's giant hero photograph, large header, slogan or course shortcut rows. This section sits immediately AFTER them. Show generous but efficient 48px outer margins, readable text, realistic web controls and implementable grid alignment, one compact section that would fit in roughly 650-750px desktop height.
Brand: primary wine #72243B, taupe #806C60, ivory #FFFAF8, pale greige #F1ECE8, white cards, dark text #2A2024, muted #68636E. NO blue, neon, glass, 3D, large decorative backgrounds, giant flowers or abstract gradients. Headings resemble DM Serif Display, body/control text Plus Jakarta Sans, 16px readable body, 38px heading, 24px card names. Subtle borders, 16px card radius, shallow soft shadows, taupe outline icons, burgundy CTA. Warm realistic campus photography in card image areas only. Keep background nearly plain light ivory. Creatively arrange actual useful content, not decorative art.
Copy: section heading exactly "Explore colleges for your goals". Short supporting copy "Find options by course, location and budget. Compare the details and build your shortlist." Clearly visible small preview label "Illustrative colleges · Demo data". Include a small "NSEDU / Section 02" eyebrow and unobtrusive concept identifier outside the product UI at the top edge.
Three preference controls: Course: B.Tech; Location: All cities; Annual tuition: Under ₹2.5 lakh. Course control implies other programs can be chosen; this is a sample selected course, not an engineering-only brand. Show main CTA "View all colleges →". Tuition is tuition only: visible understated footer copy "Tuition shown for 2026–27. Hostel and living costs are separate." No eligibility probabilities, no verified badges, rankings, ratings or fabricated review counts.
Fictional preview records, SAME throughout all concepts: Northfield Institute / Bengaluru, Karnataka / B.Tech · 4 years / ₹1.80 lakh per year; Meadow University / Pune, Maharashtra / B.Tech · 4 years / ₹2.20 lakh per year; Riverton Institute / Hyderabad, Telangana / B.Tech · 4 years / ₹1.40 lakh per year; Hillcrest College / Jaipur, Rajasthan / B.Tech · 4 years / ₹2.00 lakh per year. Each uses a different believable Indian campus photo, name, pin location, course/duration, tuition clearly labeled "Annual tuition (demo)", "View details →", a Compare checkbox and a Save bookmark. Use a compact secondary link "Admission details" instead of pretending to have verified placements/exams. Do not present any institution as real. If preference reason shown, only "Within your tuition budget"; never admission guaranteed. Different geographic locations are allowed because All cities selected.
End result should look like a professional production website screenshot with genuinely well-spaced useful content, not a moodboard, wireframe, presentation slide or a full multi-section homepage. Accurate English labels and consistent design tokens.
Layout specification:
Concept 01 / Focused College Explorer. Layout: heading and subtitle at upper left, View all colleges link aligned right. Beneath, one shallow white toolbar across the width holding the three clearly labeled dropdowns and a wine "Update options" button. Under it a tiny "Showing B.Tech options" context label. Main body is FOUR equal-width white campus cards in one horizontal row, 24px gutters. Each photo is 140-160px high with bookmark button top right. Names two-line-safe, location small, B.Tech tag. Fine horizontal divider above a two-column detail area: annual tuition large and Admission details link. Each bottom action row is View details on left and Compare checkbox on right. One card can show bookmark active, no popup. Footer directly below cards is compact and understated, with fee note left and "Save colleges to revisit later" right. Balanced, calm, easy scan. This is the clearest scalable default, no carousel arrows cutting off content.

refinement.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, precise brand colour correction. Edit this Section 2 screenshot. Change ONLY the four green 'Within your tuition budget' chips to PALE GREIGE #F1ECE8 backgrounds and WARM TAUPE #806C60 text. Absolutely preserve every layout position, all typography, photos, campus names, fees, controls, outer dimensions and all other elements exactly. This screenshot belongs to a wine #72243B + taupe #806C60 brand, no green UI accent. Do not alter natural greens in campus photographs. No other changes.
